task_description: Fix four UI regressions caused by the @vkieu/mui v2 migration: (1) TextField renders at 280px — add className='w-full'; (2) Icon inside Button children misaligns — move to leadingIcon/trailingIcon props or convert icon-only Buttons to IconButton; (3) Nested scroll container inside DialogContent — remove max-h-* and overflow-y-auto from inner wrapper divs; (4) FilterChip used as display label shows unwanted toggle checkmark — convert display-only usages to AssistChip.
